scripts.dev:discocan: npm run db:up && nx run edata-rules:build && nx run admin:graphql-generate && concurrently --kill-others --names gateway,core,fleet,admin --prefix-colors blue,green,cyan,red "npm:dev:gateway" "npm:dev:core" "npm:dev:fleet" "npm run dev:admin --ignore-scripts"
scripts.dev:admin: nx run edata-rules:build && npm run dev --workspace @discocan/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:tools && nx run-many -t typecheck
scripts.check: npm run check:admin-styles && nx affected -t build,test,test-db --output-style=static && eslint --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ .
scripts.test:full: nx run-many -t test,test-db,test-federation --skip-nx-cache --output-style=static && npm run test:smoke:admin
scripts.check:affected: npm run lint:tools && npm run typecheck:tools && nx affected -t lint,typecheck,build
scripts.db:validate: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=../../../discocan/config/core.env npm run db:validate --workspace @osnova/core && npm run db:validate --workspace @discocan/fleet && npm run db:validate --workspace @discocan/erm-server
scripts.db:migrate: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=../../../discocan/config/core.env npm run db:migrate --workspace @osnova/core && npm run db:migrate --workspace @discocan/fleet && npm run db:migrate --workspace @discocan/erm-server
scripts.db:seed: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=../../../discocan/config/core.env CORE_SEED_FILE=../../../discocan/config/core-seed.json npm run db:seed --workspace @osnova/core && npm run db:seed --workspace @discocan/fleet
scripts.prelint: npm run db:generate && npm run codegen
scripts.typecheck:tools: tsc --project discocan/tools/tsconfig.json && tsc --project osnova/tools/tsconfig.json && tsc --project tools/tsconfig.json && tsc --project holita/tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev:fleet: nx run edata-rules:build && npm run dev --workspace @discocan/fleet
scripts.db:migrate:holita: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=../../../holita/config/core.env npm run db:migrate --workspace @osnova/core && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=../../config/commerce.env npm run db:migrate --workspace @holita/commerce
